# Bundled fonts

Latin subsets from the [Fontsource](https://fontsource.org) packages, all licensed under the SIL Open Font License 1.1 (each folder has its LICENSE). Loaded by `fonts.css`; the editor offers them in the Font menu and in Settings.

Families: Inter, Nunito, Lora, Merriweather, EB Garamond, JetBrains Mono, Atkinson Hyperlegible, Caveat.
